payload.description:
## Why

0.23.1 shipped the four CLI/wiki bugs, but a clean `pip install kanbus` still feels rough: no `kbs` script, cargo-only upgrade text, a heavy runtime wheel, and Mosquitto warnings on ordinary `create`.

## Scope

1. Install a `kbs` console script from the Python package (keep `kanbus` and `kanbusr`).
2. Identical Python/Rust `kanbus-version` upgrade text that includes both pip and cargo.
3. Move test/lint/docs tools to `kanbus[dev]`; keep the CLI wheel slim. Update CI to install the extra where tests run.
4. Do not print Mosquitto-missing on issue mutations; keep the warning on explicit gossip subscribe/broker paths.

## Proof

Gherkin for the version-gate upgrade lines and for create without Mosquitto noise. Dual Python/Rust. Docs: INSTALL, CLI_REFERENCE, GETTING_STARTED.
payload.title: Polish PyPI install UX
